He succeeded his father David as president and chief executive, extending an importer built by his grandfather Martin into California vineyards and proprietary wines. His son Jake has joined the business as its fourth generation.

long_biography.plain_text:
California estates became a distinctive part of Marc D. Taub's work when he bought Heritance Vintners in Napa and developed it as Taub Family Vineyards. His family later acquired Saracina in Mendocino, where Taub worked with viticulture and soil specialists to select planting sites and drought-resistant rootstocks. These projects put the business directly into growing and making wine, alongside its established portfolio of imported producers.

Taub also leads Palm Bay International's national wine and spirits distribution. Its partnerships have brought Italian, French and other producers to American customers, while its own labels have developed in Napa and Sonoma. He brought the specialist Taub Family Selections operation under a unified Palm Bay identity, retaining its focus within the larger company. The combination of producer relationships, domestic vineyards and direct trade distribution defines the enterprise he runs today.
